blocker.summary: The exact refusal factories still mint trusted INTEGRITY_FAILURE/BLOCKED_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY projections from publicly constructible exception instances plus caller-selected producer/supporting refs, so no competent owner execution is required and refusal state/custody can be fabricated.

smallest_correction: Do not accept a bare caller-instantiated Pre553IntegrityError or Pre553AuthorityError as sufficient owner evidence.
Do not accept caller-selected producer_ref/supporting_refs as the provenance of a trusted refusal projection.
Derive the refusal and its exact object/context identity inside the competent owner execution path, or consume an existing canonical owner-produced refusal witness/receipt that binds both.
Preserve exact refusal-type distinction and all R3 G5/E/F repairs.
Add hostiles showing manually constructed exact exception instances cannot mint refusal state and a genuine refusal cannot be rebound to an unrelated exact ref.
next_action: Bounded refusal-authenticity correction followed by narrow independent rereview.
